headline: Apple's second-gen AirTags hit an all-time low of $18
script: Apple's second-generation AirTags are now selling for eighteen dollars each, an all-time low. Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy all offer that price for Black Friday. The list price for each tracker is twenty-nine dollars. Since Amazon Prime Day in late June, they have usually sold for around twenty-four dollars. A tracker is a small device you attach to things you often lose. The new ultra-wideband chip tracks location more precisely. Its range is one and a half times wider than the first-generation model. The built-in speaker is fifty percent louder than the original. That makes it easier to find an item buried in couch cushions or at the bottom of a bag. Even without those upgrades, AirTags remain a strong choice for Apple users hunting for keys or luggage. One coin cell battery lasts up to a year. The trackers work with iPhones and newer Apple Watch models.

sentences.text: Apple's second-generation AirTags are now selling for eighteen dollars each, an all-time low.
sentences.zh: 苹果第二代AirTag现在的售价是每个十八美元，创下历史新低。

sentences.text: Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy all offer that price for Black Friday.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊、沃尔玛和百思买都在黑五期间给出了这个价格。

sentences.text: The list price for each tracker is twenty-nine dollars.
sentences.zh: 每只追踪器的标价是二十九美元。

sentences.text: Since Amazon Prime Day in late June, they have usually sold for around twenty-four dollars.
sentences.zh: 自六月下旬的亚马逊会员日以来，它们通常卖二十四美元左右。

sentences.text: A tracker is a small device you attach to things you often lose.
sentences.zh: 追踪器是一种小设备，你可以把它挂在经常弄丢的东西上。

sentences.text: The new ultra-wideband chip tracks location more precisely.
sentences.zh: 新的超宽带芯片能更精准地定位。

sentences.text: Its range is one and a half times wider than the first-generation model.
sentences.zh: 它的定位范围比第一代机型宽一点五倍。

sentences.text: The built-in speaker is fifty percent louder than the original.
sentences.zh: 内置扬声器比原版响百分之五十。

sentences.text: That makes it easier to find an item buried in couch cushions or at the bottom of a bag.
sentences.zh: 这样更容易找到埋在沙发垫里或包底的东西。

sentences.text: Even without those upgrades, AirTags remain a strong choice for Apple users hunting for keys or luggage.
sentences.zh: 即使没有这些升级，AirTag对寻找钥匙或行李的苹果用户来说仍是好选择。

sentences.text: One coin cell battery lasts up to a year.
sentences.zh: 一节纽扣电池最长可用一年。

sentences.text: The trackers work with iPhones and newer Apple Watch models.
sentences.zh: 这些追踪器兼容iPhone和较新的Apple Watch机型。

terms.note: 一种用短距离无线电波测量位置的芯片，比普通蓝牙更准。
挂在钥匙、行李等物品上、帮你在手机上找到它们的小设备。
指追踪器能和手机保持联系的最远距离。
像硬币一样扁圆的小电池，这里指AirTag用的那种。

grammar.note: 表示从六月到现在一直如此，中文说“通常卖”容易漏掉have。

grammar.point: 定语从句 you attach to things
grammar.note: 省略了that/which，中文习惯把修饰语放前面，容易读不懂后置从句。
it是形式宾语，真正宾语是to find，中文没有这种结构，容易误以为it指某物。

questions.q: What is the current sale price of one AirTag?
questions.explain: 第一句直接给出十八美元的历史低价。

questions.q: How much louder is the new speaker than the original?
questions.explain: 第八句说扬声器比原版响百分之五十。
